objects.alt: Jack, a plain orange pumpkin with no face yet

objects.text: This is Jack. Tonight is Halloween, and Jack has no face yet. Follow the steps to give him one, then take the quiz.

objects.alt: A big spoon, a marker and a small saw

objects.text: A pumpkin, a big spoon, a marker, a small saw, a battery candle, and a grown-up to help.

objects.alt: A whole orange pumpkin with a green stem

objects.text: Choose one with a flat bottom and a strong green stem. Smooth skin is easiest to carve.

objects.alt: The pumpkin with a ring of cuts around its stem

objects.text: Cut a circle around the stem, angled inward so the lid will not fall in. Ask a grown-up to help with the knife.

objects.alt: The lid is off and lies beside the open pumpkin

objects.text: Use a big spoon to pull out the seeds and strings. Scrape the inside wall until it is about 3 cm thick.

objects.alt: The pumpkin with a face drawn on it in marker

objects.text: Sketch eyes, a nose and a grin with a marker. Keep shapes simple: triangles and squares are the safest.

objects.alt: The face is carved out, with a wide toothy grin

objects.text: Use a small saw. Cut with short, gentle strokes and push the pieces out from the inside.

objects.alt: The carved pumpkin glows and flickers from the light inside (animated)

objects.text: Put in a battery candle and replace the lid. Place your pumpkin by the door. Happy Halloween!

objects.alt: Bats circling the full moon over the street (animated)

objects.text: Night falls and bats circle the moon. Jack glows on the doorstep, and every trick-or-treater stops to say: what a great pumpkin!

objects.alt: A tray of roasted pumpkin seeds, still steaming

objects.text: The next morning, rinse Jack's seeds, add a little oil and salt, and bake at 160°C for about 20 minutes. A grown-up uses the oven.

objects.text: You can pick, cut, scoop, draw, carve and light a pumpkin, safely. Jack says thank you, and happy Halloween!
